Frequently Asked Questions

Rooms & Accommodation FAQ

What room categories are available at Radiant Vista?

Radiant Vista offers three verified room categories: Classic Room, Premium Room, and luxury Suite. All categories include individually controlled air conditioning and 42-inch Smart TVs.

What amenities are included in the rooms?

Standard amenities include individually controlled AC, 42-inch Smart TV, hot water kettle, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, work desks, and CCTV secure premises. Premium Rooms and Suites additionally feature mini fridges and safe deposit lockers.

Is Radiant Vista suitable for business travellers visiting Hubballi?

Yes. Radiant Vista is positioned as a business hotel on Gokul Road near Hubballi Airport, featuring a business center, meeting facilities, high-speed Wi-Fi, executive work desks, and 24/7 front desk services.

How do I book a room at Radiant Vista?

You can book directly online via our verified ResAvenue booking engine, contact reservations on WhatsApp at +91 91871 95517, or call +91 836 200 2487.
